newsitem.title: USA: Chase unit funds Colombia power plant.
newsitem.headline: Chase unit funds Colombia power plant.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp's Global Power Group said on Thursday that it had completed funding for a 199 megawatt combined cycle gas-fired electric power plant in Cali, Colombia.

Chase, which was the arranger and lead underwriter of the $114 million construction financing, said it has been advisor to KMR Power Corp on this project since 1994. Fuji Bank Ltd provided 30 percent of the financing.

KMR was awarded the $150 million Termovalle project in 1995 by Empresa de Energia del Pacifico. Marubeni Corp will build the power plant, which is expected to reach full capacity by mid-1998, Chase said.
Fuel for the plant will be provided by Empresa Colombiana de Petroleos, Chase said.
In the initial phase of the construction, gas turbines will generate 137 megawatts by late 1997, while the second phase continues.
Empresa de Energia will buy 160 megawatts of power from the plant over a 20 year period, Chase said. The balance will be sold to industrial companies, Chase said.
